SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM (
  SELECT 'class' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'class'
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
   UNION ALL
  SELECT 'function' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'function'
     AND s.line_start IS NOT NULL
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
   UNION ALL
  SELECT 'method' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'method'
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
) t
GROUP BY kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: The query identifies public symbols (names not starting with '_') of each kind—class, function, method—within the specified package, excluding test files. It then counts how many of each kind meet the public criteria.
sql:
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM (
  SELECT 'class' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'class'
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
   UNION ALL
  SELECT 'function' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'function'
     AND s.line_start IS NOT NULL
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
   UNION ALL
  SELECT 'method' AS kind, s.symbol_id
   FROM code.symbols s
   JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
   WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo'
     AND f.is_test = FALSE
     AND s.kind = 'method'
     AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
) t
GROUP BY kind
